scope: 119 public default-branch README snapshots; 118 complete recursive Git trees; OpenAI-math root tree only. Selected source/hash and successor-document comparisons, not semantic or build verification of every repository.
source_exclusions: __init__.py; empty or boilerplate package markers are not substantive duplicates
limits: Equal source blobs establish copied bytes, not independent results or full semantic equivalence.
Similar names, age, sparse documentation and fork status alone do not establish obsolescence.
No wholesale repository replacement is established by the partial overlap findings.
Lean model proofs, finite Python correspondence and complete Zoo implementation equivalence remain distinct.
